prompt:
Score each onboarding change. Sub-scores:
- impact 0-3: how many users the targeted step loses and how much this could recover
- evidence 0-3: whether the funnel and the support mail both point at this problem
- confidence 0-2: how likely this kind of change works, judged from the lessons below
- cost 0-2: 2 = config only, 0 = needs new screens and a release
Also give predicted_lift: expected relative change in the target step's conversion, e.g. 0.05.

Changes:
0: [choose_path, redesign] choose_path_card_redesign: Redesign the path selection screen into a card-based interactive layout with preview animations of pets. (why: The choose_path step currently has a high mean time of 514s and 76.2% conversion, showing users hesitate when selecting how to start.)
1: [sign_in, redesign] sign_in_account_sync_redesign: Redesign the sign-in screen to a split layout emphasizing cloud save protection and pet recovery. (why: 8 support emails complained about pets missing or reset after signing in again, indicating confusion around account linkage.)
2: [adoption, new_flow] adoption_customization_new_flow: Introduce a dedicated accessory selection step within adoption to let users customize their pet before final certificate signing. (why: Adoption has a low conversion rate of 60.9% and a median duration of 89s, plus 3 support reports of custom pet issues.)
3: [home, new_screen] home_desktop_compatibility_check_screen: Insert a pre-desktop verification screen during waiting to confirm screen permissions and display readiness. (why: 3 support tickets reported pets failing to appear on the desktop or the app stalling prior to launch.)
4: [sign_in, copy] sign_in_data_privacy_reassurance_copy: Update headline and body copy on sign_in to explicitly reassure users about seamless sign-in and data retention. (why: Sign-in conversion drops to 72.9% with a mean duration of 567s; clear copy reduces login friction and privacy concerns.)
5: [home, wait_info] waiting_status_timer_wait_info: Add an explicit live countdown timer and time estimate text to the pet generation waiting screen. (why: The waiting step in home has a high mean duration of 2336s, leading to drop-offs when users do not know how long generation takes.)
6: [adoption, hint] pick_friend_trait_selection_hint: Add a descriptive hint below pet selection choices explaining pet personality traits and desktop behaviors. (why: Users reported confusion after onboarding regarding how to interact with and control their pets.)
7: [home, notification] waiting_completion_desktop_notification: Enable background desktop notification toggle on the waiting screen so users get alerted when pet rendering completes. (why: Long wait times (median 201s, mean 2336s) cause users to minimize the app and forget to complete onboarding.)
